integrity: The claim is an analytic extension at the omitted equality case. Finite symbolic checking is used only for algebraic cancellation; asymptotic convergence is proved by Lyapunov, Barbalat, comparison, and transport arguments.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the printed nonnegative bounded age-structured predator-prey disease system with bounded nonnegative fertility and the stated recruitment law.
No convergence rate for the infected prey is claimed at the critical surface.
No statement is made about endemic/positive equilibria or altered incidence and predator-recruitment laws.
title: The critical disease threshold is globally asymptotically stable
